map_value_analysis.observed_retrieval_impact: Map coordinates enabled spatial proximity candidate generation for 5/5 coordinate cases (producing 85, 119, 3, 38, and 109 candidates respectively, total 354 candidates), compared to 0 candidates in V1 for all 5 cases. However, because exact ground truth addresses are unresolved and the true neighbourhoods are largely absent from the candidate corpus, spatial accuracy against true property identity cannot be legitimately evaluated.

measured_corpus_coverage_diagnostics.measured_finding: Candidate corpus coverage is a demonstrated structural barrier to retrieval: 9 of 10 sampled listings belong to neighbourhoods completely absent from acervo_casas_taubate.json.

pre_registered_benchmark_assessment.methodological_conclusion: No exact independent ground truth (street + house number) is available for any of the 10 real-world listings in public records. Exact Top-K scoring cannot be performed without manufacturing false misses. Both candidate generation and ground truth resolution identify public number withholding and corpus geographic boundary truncation as the primary operational hurdles.
